novel_features.name: Cross-Instance Workflow Diff
novel_features.description: Diff workflow inventories between two n8n instances — missing, active mismatches, name changes.

novel_features.name: Instance Health Compare
novel_features.description: Side-by-side workflow counts and reachability for two n8n instances.

novel_features.name: Stale Workflow Detection
novel_features.description: List workflows not updated within N days — find dormant automations before they become liabilities. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Credential Reference Audit
novel_features.description: Cross-reference every credential with the workflows using it — find unused and high-impact credentials. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Node Type Inventory
novel_features.description: Count every n8n node type across all workflows — map your automation footprint and audit community node dependencies. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Workflow Dependency Map
novel_features.description: Map execution chains via executeWorkflow nodes — see what calls what and who would break if a workflow is deleted. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Execution CI Gate
novel_features.description: Poll an execution until it reaches a terminal state — blocks CI/CD pipelines on real n8n workflow results.

novel_features.name: Runaway Trigger Detection
novel_features.description: Flag workflows executing above a per-minute threshold — catch infinite loops and webhook storms before they degrade instance health. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.

novel_features.name: Variable Drift Detection
novel_features.description: Compare environment variables between two n8n instances — find missing keys or value mismatches before deployment.

novel_features.name: Bulk Workflow Management
novel_features.description: Activate, deactivate, or archive multiple workflows at once filtered by tag or name — hours of clicking replaced by one command.

novel_features.name: Execution History Export
novel_features.description: Export structured execution history filtered by workflow, status, and time window for audit logs and analytics pipelines. Requires a local sync first: `n8n-pp-cli sync`.
